description: Advanced ERP solutions tailored for rubber manufacturers, optimizing compound formulation, production processes and quality control while ensuring efficient material utilization and process consistency.

infoCards.title: Mixing Control
infoCards.description: Advanced mixing and compounding control system for rubber manufacturing.

infoCards.title: Quality Testing
infoCards.description: Comprehensive quality control and testing system for rubber products.

faqData.question: How does the system handle compound formulation?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive compound management including recipe formulation, material specifications, mixing parameters and batch tracking with complete traceability.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced quality testing with physical property analysis, rheology testing, aging studies and detailed quality reporting for various rubber compounds and products.

faqData.question: Can it manage process parameters?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages process parameters with real-time monitoring, temperature control, curing profiles and automated adjustments for optimal production conditions.
